title: Image Bible — approved selection
coverage: Original pin and related images inspected across eight downward scroll passes; 101 unique pins after removing one repeated seed thumbnail. Pinterest continues recommending images, so this is a bounded first pass, not an exhaustive board export.
status: Approved creative reference library. No LoRA weights are included in this public package.
camera_and_lighting_note: Lighting, lens feel and film-like treatment are visual interpretations, not verified camera, lens, film-stock or lighting metadata.
training_note: Saved files are review previews. None of the new images were generated by this project. Original authorship, photographic versus synthetic provenance, permissions and suitable full-resolution source files remain unverified. Review those before training.
duplicate_removed: P083 repeated the original pin P001; IDs remain stable.

groups.name: People in real workplaces
groups.description: Relaxed environmental portraits. Soft side light or doorway light; worn wood, clay, cloth and metal; warm neutrals, olive and restrained blue. The room remains legible around the person.
groups.framing: Eye-level, medium or full-body, enough space to read the setting. Foreground objects can partly frame the view.
groups.video: Begin with a still-feeling environmental shot, then a small glance, smile or weight shift. Keep the camera quiet and the room visible.

groups.name: Hands, materials and making
groups.description: Concentrated work and in-between gestures. Hands, tools, dust, fabric folds and unfinished surfaces supply the detail. Directional daylight and selective focus give depth.
groups.framing: Mix an environmental working view with close details of hands and materials. A partial body or obscured foreground is welcome.
groups.video: Show a complete small action: shaping clay, planing wood or tying an apron. Pair the wider shot with a detail; preserve believable contact and motion.

groups.name: Slow everyday life
groups.description: Coffee, sofas, kitchens and personal studios. Window light, relaxed limbs, lived-in objects and intimate distance; warm wood balanced by muted greens and blues.
groups.framing: Unforced seated or leaning poses, some negative space, occasional blurred foreground, soft light falling unevenly through a room.
groups.video: Hold on a modest action such as pouring, reading or lifting a mug. Use a locked frame or restrained handheld movement and natural pauses.

groups.name: Sun, shade and open air
groups.description: Casual outdoor moments around streets, porches, vehicles and fields. Natural sun or open shade, unforced gestures and color accents; the landscape stays part of the story.
groups.framing: Allow sky, building edges or foreground vegetation into the frame. Vary low and eye-level viewpoints without extreme lens distortion.
groups.video: Use small environmental movement, slow walking and informal interaction. Preserve the direction of the sunlight and avoid constant camera motion.

groups.name: Direct-flash candid energy
groups.description: Bright frontal subjects, distinct shadows and darker backgrounds. Stronger blues and reds, playful expressions and a more abrupt snapshot feeling. This is a separate lighting branch.
groups.framing: Conversational distance, candid crops and a readable surrounding room. A little awkwardness belongs to the mood.
groups.video: Use a harder near-camera light and short candid moments to echo the stills. Repeated flashes are not needed to transfer the look.

groups.name: Fashion and commercial scenes
groups.description: Plain studio backgrounds, carefully presented clothing or products, and some exaggerated commercial setups. These share parts of the palette but have a more constructed feel.
groups.framing: Simpler settings and deliberate product or outfit presentation. Some examples include text, borders or changing carousel frames.
groups.video: Use the retained references for a separate styled campaign treatment. The five excluded images must not guide new work.
